info.title: TMS API
info.description: Versioned production contract for accepted TMS behavior. All timestamps are UTC RFC 3339 values, all identifiers are opaque, and all cursors and ETags must be treated as opaque strings.

get.description: Returns ok only when PostgreSQL is reachable and its migration ledger is compatible with the running artifact. Stage A accepts 0017 through 0018 with both new feature flags disabled; Stage B requires exactly 0018.

get.summary: Discover and read a bounded workspace shell
get.description: Selects the only active workspace membership when workspaceId is omitted. Principals with zero or multiple active memberships must provide workspaceId. This never returns unbounded case, suite, run, defect, dashboard, attachment, or activity collections; clients hydrate them through paginated endpoints.

get.summary: Read the bounded initial workspace projection
get.description: Replaces the unbounded prototype bootstrap dump. The response is versioned as workspace-summary.v1, is capped at 262144 encoded bytes, and contains only summary records. Clients use paginated collection endpoints for complete data.

parameters.name: recentLimit
parameters.description: Maximum records in each recent-items section.

patch.description: Updates mutable fields on an active project. Archive and restore are explicit lifecycle operations; archived projects reject PATCH.

delete.description: Archives the project; it never hard-deletes project history.

patch.description: Updates mutable fields on an active environment. Archive and restore are explicit lifecycle operations; archived environments reject PATCH.

get.description: Returns bounded case summaries with their current revision only. Revision history is paginated separately.

post.summary: Create a test case and revision 1

patch.summary: Atomically revise lifecycle or priority for explicit test cases
patch.description: Validates the full authorized project-scoped selection and every strong per-case ETag before writing. Changed cases receive one immutable revision; cases already at the requested values are returned unchanged without a revision, audit event, or outbox message. The command never partially succeeds.

get.summary: Get a test case at its current revision

patch.summary: Create the next immutable test-case revision
patch.description: Never overwrites historical revisions. If-Match is the ETag returned for the current case representation.

get.summary: List append-only tester comments newest first

post.summary: Append a tester comment without revising test-case content

get.summary: List defect reports linked to this case or exact historical step

post.summary: Clone the current revision into a new test case
Create a static or dynamic suite

get.description: resolvedCaseCount previews the currently resolvable, non-archived cases. For a static suite it can be lower than caseCount after a member is archived. Immutable suite resolutions snapshot current revision numbers; a future run references a resolutionId.

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: False by default. True includes archived runs without hiding historical evidence.

post.summary: Create a run with immutable case and environment snapshots
post.description: Exactly one of suiteId or caseIds selects the scope. A suite is resolved once into an immutable resolution; explicit caseIds store no suite provenance. Archived, stale, or cross-project resources are rejected.

get.description: Run items and attempt history are paginated through their owned endpoints.

delete.summary: Archive a run without deleting execution evidence
delete.description: Removes the run from default active lists while preserving items, attempts, defects, attachments, and audit history. Restore is explicit.

post.description: Fails with CONFLICT and safe unfinishedItems details until every item is passed, failed, blocked, or skipped.

get.summary: Get a run item and its active attempt

patch.description: passed requires every required step to be passed; failed requires actualResult or comment; blocked requires a reason. Invalid transitions return stable domain codes.

patch.summary: Submit a step or checklist result

get.summary: Get one preserved attempt with bounded step results

post.summary: Create the next attempt without overwriting history

patch.summary: Update defect fields without bypassing lifecycle rules

post.summary: Apply an explicit defect status transition
Confirm a fix from exact successful post-ready retest evidence
post.description: Requires a linked YouTrack issue, ready_for_retest lifecycle, the same immutable case snapshot, and a passed exact step when the report is step-scoped. Writes verification, transition, audit, and YouTrack outbox atomically.

get.description: Returns active links by default. Owner filters are exact and tenant-scoped; quarantined legacy links are audit provenance and are never exposed as active resources.

parameters.name: ownerId
parameters.description: Required together with ownerKind; interpreted as caseId, runId, or defectId.

parameters.name: runItemId
parameters.description: Optional only when ownerKind is run.

post.summary: Archive an external link without deleting history

get.description: Returns bounded metadata for every lifecycle state, including deleted tombstones retained for history. Object keys and provider details are never exposed.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Optional exact owner selector. Required IDs are enforced by its discriminated owner schema.

post.description: Authorizes the typed immutable owner, selects the trusted extension from the active media policy, persists the upload deadline with pending private metadata, and returns an expiring URL for exactly one object. Idempotent replays never extend the persisted deadline. No read access is available until finalize verifies the object.

post.summary: Finalize and verify an uploaded object
post.description: Before the persisted upload deadline, HEAD-verifies the private object, byte size, exact declared Content-Type, storage ETag, and SHA-256, then conditionally reads at most the first 65536 bytes to validate the active content-signature/text profile. A media mismatch is quarantined with ATTACHMENT_MEDIA_MISMATCH; incomplete provider evidence never becomes ready. Completed results replay for the same principal, key, and canonical request without repeating storage inspection.

delete.summary: Request deletion of a private attachment
delete.description: Moves ready, failed, or quarantined evidence to deleting. A bounded cleanup worker removes the exact private R2 object and retains a deleted metadata tombstone for audit history.

post.summary: Authorize and mint short-lived signed read access
post.description: Available only while status is ready. The private URL is never persisted in DTOs or activity, expires in at most five minutes, and must not be cached. Pending, failed, quarantined, deleting, and deleted objects never receive signed read access.

get.summary: Read bounded testing analytics and transparent risk hotspots
get.description: Returns current inventory separately from event-window metrics. Product means canonical Project; Component is free text and remains a separate dimension. Workspace scope includes active Projects only, while an explicit projectId may select an archived Project. Tag buckets are multi-valued and are not a pie total. Risk hotspots expose raw counts and rates and use the documented deterministic ordering rather than an opaque score. Work is capped at 1,000 Projects, 2,000 event runs and 100,000 run items.

get.summary: Drill into an exact test-case analytics cohort
get.description: current is the live inventory at request time; created uses createdAt in the inclusive-from, exclusive-to window. Current-revision dimensions and coverage apply only to current. componentIsEmpty represents the null/empty Component bucket. coverage means a current case did or did not appear in a run started in the exact period.

get.summary: Drill into an exact run analytics cohort
get.description: launched uses startedAt; completed uses completedAt or abortedAt; active is the current live set and ignores the period. A passed outcome requires every run item to pass; any skipped item makes an otherwise terminal run incomplete. Component and itemStatus are container filters that select runs containing a matching immutable case snapshot item. Use the run-items drill when a displayed item count must reconcile 1:1.

get.summary: Drill into exact completed-run item counts
get.description: Returns one row per run item, so meta.total reconciles 1:1 with timeline completedItems and every risk run-item count. The half-open event window uses the parent run completedAt or abortedAt. Omit status for total runItemsInPeriod; use a terminal status for timeline item counts. Component is read from the immutable case revision referenced by the run snapshot; componentIsEmpty selects its null/empty bucket.

get.summary: Drill into an exact defect analytics cohort with safe links
get.description: reported uses createdAt in the period and includes archived records; current is the live non-archived set and ignores the period. Returned links are Falcon or active HTTPS external/YouTrack links only. occurrence identifies the immutable originating run item, case revision and step. Current risk filters reproduce Component, active/open and critical hotspot cohorts.

parameters.name: hasLink
parameters.description: Filters active safe HTTPS external/YouTrack links. The always-present Falcon resource link is not part of this predicate.

get.summary: List bounded dashboard summaries newest first
get.description: When projectId is supplied, returns workspace-level dashboards and dashboards for that project. Widget definitions are hydrated only through the singleton resource.

get.summary: Get one dashboard with at most 100 widgets

patch.summary: Replace mutable dashboard fields or its bounded widget layout
patch.description: Archived dashboards reject PATCH. Widget replacement is transactional with the dashboard version and never returns an unbounded collection.

post.summary: Archive a dashboard without deleting history
Restore an archived dashboard as non-default
Accept an authenticated YouTrack lifecycle webhook

204.description: Webhook accepted or replayed by its canonical payload hash.

get.summary: List append-only workspace activity newest first

bearerAuth.description: Production access token. The prototype x-actor header is not authentication and is not part of this contract.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Optional caller correlation ID. The server validates its safe character/length policy or generates a new value, and always returns the effective ID.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to the authenticated principal, operation, and workspace. Reusing it with a different canonical request returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Completed responses are replayable for at least 24 hours.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact strong ETag from the last authorized singleton read or mutation. Wildcard matching is not accepted.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned as meta.nextCursor or X-Next-Cursor. It is bound to the original filters and ordering.

WorkspaceIdQueryRequired.name: workspaceId
WorkspaceIdQueryRequired.description: Required tenant boundary for the query.

YouTrackWebhookToken.name: X-YouTrack-Token
YouTrackWebhookToken.description: Shared 64-character hexadecimal webhook secret. It is never returned or logged.

AnalyticsPeriodQuery.name: period
AnalyticsPeriodQuery.description: Server-owned UTC event window preset. Presets reject from/to; custom requires both exact bounds and is capped at 366 days. Preset bounds are frozen into every continuation cursor.

AnalyticsFromQuery.name: from
AnalyticsFromQuery.description: Inclusive UTC bound. Required only with period=custom.

AnalyticsToQuery.name: to
AnalyticsToQuery.description: Exclusive UTC bound. Required only with period=custom and cannot be in the future.

ProjectIdQueryRequired.name: projectId
ProjectIdQueryRequired.description: Required project scope; cross-project reads are never performed and filtered afterward.

XRequestId.description: Effective request correlation ID; identical to error.requestId on failures.

ETag.description: Strong opaque representation version for a singleton resource or its aggregate concurrency boundary.

XNextCursor.description: Opaque next cursor. Omitted on the final page and equal to meta.nextCursor when present.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: true only when this response was replayed from a completed idempotent command.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the client may retry.

CacheControlNoStore.description: Signed access responses are private and must not be cached.

HealthResponse.description: Service is ready to accept requests.

ProjectListResponse.description: A page of projects ordered by key then ID.

EnvironmentListResponse.description: A page of environments ordered by key then ID.

EnvironmentResponse.description: Environment representation. Secret values are never serialized.

TestCaseListResponse.description: A page of bounded test-case summaries ordered by updatedAt descending then ID.

TestCaseResponse.description: Test case with current revision only.

TestCaseBulkMutationResponse.description: All requested cases in request order, with changed and unchanged counts.

TestCaseBulkPreconditionFailed.description: At least one supplied per-case ETag is malformed, belongs to another case, or is stale. No case is changed.

TestCaseRevisionListResponse.description: A page of bounded immutable revision summaries.

TestCaseCommentListResponse.description: A bounded page of append-only comments ordered newest first.

TestCaseCommentResponse.description: New or idempotently replayed append-only comment.

TestCaseLinkedDefectListResponse.description: A bounded case and historical-step defect trace ordered by report time.

SuiteListResponse.description: A page of bounded suite summaries ordered by key then ID.

RunListResponse.description: A page of run summaries ordered by run key then ID; archived runs are excluded unless requested.

RunResponse.description: Run summary; items are paginated separately.

RunItemListResponse.description: A page of immutable run-item snapshots.

RunAttemptListResponse.description: A page of preserved attempts ordered newest first.

RunAttemptResponse.description: One immutable attempt with at most 500 step results.

StepResultResponse.description: Updated step result and its aggregate identifiers.

DefectListResponse.description: A page of defects ordered by createdAt descending then ID.

DefectFixConfirmationResponse.description: Verified local defect and a durable pending YouTrack transition.

AttachmentListResponse.description: A page of private attachment metadata ordered by createdAt descending then ID.

AttachmentResponse.description: Private attachment metadata without a storage key or public URL.

AttachmentUploadIntentResponse.description: Expiring upload instructions for one object.

ExternalLinkListResponse.description: A page of scoped external-link metadata ordered newest first.

ActivityListResponse.description: A page of safe append-only audit events ordered newest first.

YouTrackIntegrationStatusResponse.description: Bounded workspace-scoped YouTrack synchronization status without credentials.

DashboardAnalyticsSummaryResponse.description: Bounded current inventory, event-window metrics and transparent risk hotspots. Counts and drill filters share server-owned semantics.

DashboardAnalyticsTestCaseListResponse.description: A bounded exact test-case cohort ordered by immutable createdAt then ID, newest first.

DashboardAnalyticsRunListResponse.description: A bounded exact run cohort ordered by its immutable basis event time then ID, newest first.

DashboardAnalyticsRunItemListResponse.description: A bounded exact run-item cohort ordered by parent run event time, run ID and item ID, newest first. meta.total is the exact bounded cohort count.

DashboardAnalyticsDefectListResponse.description: A bounded exact defect cohort ordered by immutable createdAt then ID, newest first, with safe links and originating occurrence.

DashboardListResponse.description: A page of bounded dashboard summaries ordered newest first.

DashboardResponse.description: One dashboard with no more than 100 safe widget definitions.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or fails safe field validation.

Unauthorized.description: A valid bearer principal is required.

Forbidden.description: The principal is authenticated but lacks workspace permission.

NotFound.description: The scoped resource does not exist or is intentionally concealed.

Conflict.description: A stable domain transition, uniqueness, or idempotency conflict.

Gone.description: The upload intent expired and cannot be finalized.

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not equal the current representation ETag.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The declared attachment exceeds the configured policy.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The attachment media type is not permitted.

PreconditionRequired.description: A required If-Match header is missing.

AnalyticsLimitExceeded.description: The selected project or event cohort exceeds the bounded analytics load budget. Narrow the Project or time period and retry.

AnalyticsUnavailable.description: The bounded analytics query reached its statement or lock timeout. The client may retry or choose a narrower scope.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error; internal details are never exposed.

Identifier.description: Opaque identifier; clients must not parse prefixes or embed business meaning.

AnalyticsCount.description: Non-negative server-owned count within JavaScript safe-integer range.

periodApplied.description: False for live current/active bases that intentionally ignore the event window.

AnalyticsRunOutcome.description: passed requires every run item to pass; a terminal run containing skipped items is incomplete.

byTag.description: Multi-valued tag buckets overlap and are not a pie total.

byComponent.description: Available only for explicit Project scope. Null/empty Component uses a null bucket key.

start.description: Inclusive exact UTC bound. Drill launched runs with basis=launched, outcomes with basis=completed, or item counts through /dashboard-analytics/run-items; use period=custom, from=start and to=end.

passRate.description: passed items divided by passed+failed+blocked items; skipped items are excluded. Null when that denominator is zero.

granularity.description: day for 7d/30d and custom windows no longer than 31 exact days; otherwise week. Buckets are fixed 24h/168h intervals anchored at period.from, not local calendar boundaries.

buckets.description: Server-zero-filled contiguous half-open buckets; the final bucket may be shorter and ends exactly at period.to.

runItemsInPeriod.description: Exact /dashboard-analytics/run-items total with matching Project/Component and no status filter.

asOf.description: Live snapshot statement time for all current sections; this is not a historical as-of query.

eventAt.description: Parent run completedAt or abortedAt, used as the immutable half-open period and cursor basis.

links.description: Always starts with the safe Falcon resource link, followed by at most five active HTTPS external/YouTrack links.

ErrorDetails.description: Safe structured context only. Never contains stack traces, SQL, storage keys, secrets, or signed URLs.

baseUrl.description: Public HTTP(S) base URL without embedded username or password credentials.
Public HTTP(S) base URL without embedded username or password credentials.

variables.description: Public values only. Variable names containing password, secret, token, private key, or API key markers are rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR.

baseUrl.description: Public HTTP(S) base URL without embedded username or password credentials.

variables.description: Public values only. Variable names containing password, secret, token, private key, or API key markers are rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR.

type.description: The server validates the fully resolved revision. Automated revisions require at least one complete step and an empty checklist; manual revisions keep their existing zero-step allowance.
Validated against the fully resolved revision: automated requires at least one complete step and an empty checklist; manual may have zero steps.

TestCaseLinkedDefectOccurrence.description: Immutable occurrence and step label captured by the original run snapshot.

DefectYouTrackCreation.description: Durable initial YouTrack delivery truth for a routed defect. Null on deliberately TMS-only defects.

readyForTest.description: True only when Falcon is ready for retest, YouTrack is in a ready/acceptance state, and the production workflow guard has been verified and enabled.

items.description: Explicit targets. caseId values must be unique; the server validates this independently of full-object uniqueness.

caseCount.description: Stored explicit membership count for static suites; always zero for dynamic suites.

resolvedCaseCount.description: Current server-owned preview excluding archived case aggregates; it does not create a resolution snapshot.

suiteResolutionId.description: Immutable suite resolution used for reproducibility; null for explicit caseIds.

attachmentIds.description: Ready private attachments owned by this run.

caseIds.description: Exact explicit scope in request order.

configuration.description: Public strings only. Secret-like property names are rejected.

assigneeIdentityId.description: An active identity with active workspace membership, or null.

labels.description: Normalized labels. Occurrence defects include two immutable server-derived provenance labels: <case-type>-run and the run type.
Client labels. When runId/runItemId identify an occurrence, at most 98 are accepted and provenance names are reserved for two immutable server-derived labels.
Replacement client labels. Existing occurrence defects accept at most 98 and always preserve/recompute their two reserved provenance labels.

AttachmentFailureCode.description: Safe lifecycle reason persisted with failed or quarantined private metadata.

AttachmentMimeType.description: Closed server policy. Finalize requires the exact stored Content-Type and bounded content validation; application/octet-stream is intentionally opaque.

TrustedAttachmentExtension.description: Selected by the server from the active MIME policy; never accepted from the client.

Attachment.description: Private object metadata. Bucket, object key, provider details, and reusable public URLs are never exposed.

expiresAt.description: Expiry of the returned signed upload URL. The server persists the first intent deadline; replayed credentials may expire earlier and never extend that deadline. Finalization at or after the persisted deadline returns UPLOAD_INTENT_EXPIRED.

targetUri.description: URL and external_issue targets must be HTTPS without credentials. Deep links use an explicit lowercase scheme followed by ://.

DashboardWidgetSettings.description: At most 8192 encoded bytes and four nested levels. Secret-like keys and non-JSON values are rejected.

details.description: Safe redacted metadata only, capped at 8192 encoded bytes and four nested levels. Secrets, environment values, request bodies, storage keys, credential-bearing URLs, and signed URLs are forbidden.
